text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Caution should be exercised to prevent inadvertent overdose [see Use in Specific Populations (8.5 , 8.6) ] . Precipitation of acyclovir in renal tubules may occur when the solubility (2.5 mg/mL) is exceeded in the intratubular fluid. In the event of acute renal failure and anuria, the patient may benefit from hemodialysis until renal function is restored [see Dosage and Administration (2.4) ] .
